article.title: 新加坡UNIQLO聯乘吉卜力，串連展覽集印與門店換領
article.summary: UNIQLO新加坡公布與吉卜力工作室合作的新UT系列。據Marketing-Interactive報道，當地安排優先發售和展覽集印。
highlights: 系列圖案取材自吉卜力作品、插畫及展覽海報等。
按當地計劃，參觀者可在展覽集印，再到指定分店換領徽章。
article.why: 品牌可用跨場地兌換連接展覽參與與門店到訪，並分開記錄兩個環節。
article.next_step: 策劃聯乘時先定好集印位置、兌換分店和數量，再用同一識別碼追蹤。
article.detail: UNIQLO新加坡的官方系列頁列出吉卜力作品、照片、插畫及海報等視覺素材。Marketing-Interactive報道，當地計劃在Orchard Central旗艦店舉辦優先發售，並與Gardens by the Bay的展覽合作，安排參觀者集印後到指定UNIQLO門店換領徽章。
article.title_en: UNIQLO Singapore ties Studio Ghibli exhibition stamps to store redemption
article.summary_en: UNIQLO Singapore announced a Studio Ghibli UT collection. Marketing-Interactive reported local plans for an advance sale and an exhibition stamp rally.
highlights_en: The designs draw on Studio Ghibli works, illustrations and exhibition posters.
The Singapore plan links exhibition stamps to pin redemption at participating stores.
article.why_en: Brands can connect exhibition visits and store traffic with redemption and measure each step separately.
article.next_step_en: Set stamp locations, redemption stores and quantities before a collaboration, then track the steps with a shared identifier.
article.detail_en: UNIQLO Singapore's collection page lists Studio Ghibli works, photos, illustrations and posters as visual sources. Marketing-Interactive reported plans for an advance sale at the Orchard Central flagship and a partnership with an exhibition at Gardens by the Bay. Visitors would collect stamps at the exhibition before redeeming a pin at participating UNIQLO stores.
